rubric_items.reason: All 15 known REQs (REQ-1 to REQ-15) are traced by S-1 to S-6; no assumed REQs exist in the intent.
Stories are small; S-3 groups three list behaviours (status filter, date range, paging) and S-1 four REQs, but each still delivers one user outcome.
ACs are Given/When/Then with good 60/61-character and NULL boundaries; S-6 AC1 only checks visible columns, so a payload leak of medical history would pass.
The 60-character limit, "-" placeholder and no-tooltip rule all come from the intent; reason strings are example test data, not limits.
Readable and consistent terms; claim C4 is worded so it reads as if the list shows the full reason.

findings.text: Claim C4 reads as if the list shows the full reason, the opposite of A-02 and REQ-7 (no tooltip or hover text with the full reason).

cites.quote: The list shows `No tooltip` with the full reason.

findings.suggested_fix: Reword C4 to: "The list shows no tooltip or hover text with the full reason."

findings.text: S-6 AC1 checks only the visible columns. An implementation that sends the patient's medical history in the list response but does not render it would still pass.

cites.quote: then no medical history value of that patient appears in any column
Medical history appears only on the patient's own page, never in lists, the dashboard or logs.

findings.suggested_fix: Add a check that the appointment list response carries no medical history fields for the patient, not only that no column shows them.
